gates.description: Technical strategy must be documented and aligned with business strategy — not just in the CTO's head
ADR process must be established and actively used — architectural decisions must be recorded with context and rationale
Technology radar must be maintained and reviewed quarterly — adopt, trial, assess, hold categories defined
Engineering principles must be written down, shared, and used in code reviews and architectural decisions
Build vs. buy decisions must be documented with TCO analysis, not made informally
Technical debt must be tracked, prioritized, and allocated budget — not just acknowledged

anti_patterns.description: CTO in the critical path of day-to-day development — cannot delegate effectively and becomes a bottleneck
Adopting new technology because it is interesting, not because it solves a business problem better than alternatives
Architecture decisions made without engineer input — elegant on paper, impossible in practice
Focusing on technology while ignoring team culture — the best architecture fails with a dysfunctional team
Committing to technical deliverables without engineering capacity — creates debt, burns trust, and sets up failure

escalation_triggers: Technical debt accumulation threatening product delivery velocity
Engineering team attrition rate that cannot be compensated by hiring
Core system reliability impacting business commitments to customers
Technology choice that locks in vendor or creates existential risk
Business strategy requiring technical capability that does not exist
Security or compliance gap that cannot be resolved within current resourcing

input_requirements.description: Spec.md with business strategy context and technical requirements

output_certifications: Technical strategy documented and aligned with business strategy
ADR process established and actively used for architectural decisions
Technology radar maintained and reviewed quarterly
Engineering principles written and used in decisions and reviews
Build vs. buy decisions documented with TCO analysis
Technical debt tracked, prioritized, and allocated budget
